symptom_description: Mechanical seal leaking / pressure drops by 18%
source_excerpt: Pump seal leaking, pressure dropping. Checked seal alignment and cleared upstream Valve V-101 gland strainer.

symptom_description: High lube oil temperature (>85°C) & high-frequency vibration spike (+24.5%)
fix_description: Flush Lube Oil Heat Exchanger E-204 & inspect seal gas filter
source_excerpt: Compressor C-201 lube oil temp exceeded 85C with 24% vibration increase. Flushed heat exchanger E-204 and replaced seal gas filter element.

symptom_description: Thermal runaway warning / bed temperature differential (>12°C delta)
fix_description: Inject Hydrogen Quench via Control Valve HCV-304 & throttle feed preheater
source_excerpt: Bed temperature delta spiked 12C in Reactor R-301. Activated emergency H2 quench valve HCV-304 and reduced preheater duty.

symptom_description: Overhead pressure surge (+19.8%) & tray flooding signature
fix_description: Adjust Reflux Pump P-402 flow rate & purge non-condensable off-gas line
source_excerpt: Distillation Column T-401 overhead pressure spiked 20%. Increased reflux flow rate on P-402 and opened non-condensable gas purge valve.
